title: Queen of the Market
bio: Fish vendor at the market. Haggles the price of everything, including your dignity. Fixed price, no discounts.

player_low_cards: Uy, only a few left. Still haggling, or giving up?
You're about to win. How much? That part's negotiable!
Fast, ha, like the morning rush!
self_low_cards: Low on stock, this is the last piece!
Almost done. No haggling, the price is fixed!
One card, like the last bangus in the sink.
self_winning_soon: Out of stock, I'm winning, suki!
One piece left, then I'm closing shop!
got_ipit: Ay! You blocked me like a rigged scale!
Oh, is that it? That play of yours is spoiled goods, kid!
Hoy! None of that at my stall!
table_cleared: Nothing left, like bangus by noon.
played_big_combo: Five cards! Fresh from the market!
Combo! This is the bestseller, no discount!
Five! Weigh that, it's over the asking price!
